1 7:36 What does she say she has to redeem herself from??Over a decade of demonising stress.
2 7:48 What is one of the most under-appreciated aspects of stress??That stress makes you social — it pushes you to connect with other people.
3 8:04 What nickname did oxytocin get??The cuddle hormone, because it is released when you hug someone.
4 8:32 What does oxytocin prime us to do??It primes us to do things that strengthen close relationships, like crave physical contact and support the people we care about.
5 8:41 What do some people suggest we should be doing??Some people have suggested we should snort oxytocin to become more compassionate and caring.
6 9:01 What don't most people understand about oxytocin??That it is also a stress hormone — released by the pituitary gland as part of the stress response.
7 9:15 What motivates us to seek support??Oxytocin — it nudges us to tell someone how we feel instead of bottling it up.
8 9:32 How does the stress response influence our relationships??It makes us notice when someone close is struggling and encourages us to support each other.
9 9:55 What are some of the main roles of oxytocin??It strengthens close relationships and protects the cardiovascular system from the effects of stress.
10 10:14 What effects does this hormone have on the heart??It helps heart cells regenerate and heal from stress-induced damage, which strengthens the heart.
11 10:36 Under what circumstances do we release more oxytocin??When we reach out to others under stress — either to seek support or to help someone else.
12 10:49 What is a built-in mechanism we have for stress resilience??Human connection — reaching out to others.
